what: Two consecutive /lidar_points messages (sensor_msgs/msg/PointCloud2, ROS 2 CDR, as stored in the bag) cut from a real Hesai JT16 recording
source: Metrolla-Inc/HesaiDriver main, HesaiLidar_ROS_2.0/jt16-r2/jt16-r2_0.mcap (rosbag2 MCAP, recorded 2025-08-23, 168 clouds, 33.8 s)
note: The bag holds decoded clouds and IMU only, no raw packets, so it cannot be replayed into the driver; it pins the PointCloud2 layout the Hesai driver published on a real sensor.
